what: POST the capsule's otlp/spans.json, and an OTLP protobuf encoding of the same spans, to a real Phoenix OTLP/HTTP receiver, then read the spans back through Phoenix's own client.

capsule.made_by: recovery of a 6-frame tape (RUN_START, NODE_OPEN, MODEL_REQUEST, MODEL_RESPONSE, NODE_CLOSE, RUN_END); not a proxied run

results.verdict: NOT ACCEPTED — Phoenix 21.0.0's OTLP/HTTP receiver speaks protobuf only

results.attempt: google.protobuf.json_format.Parse of the same document into ExportTraceServiceRequest, after adapting traceId/spanId/parentSpanId from OTLP/JSON's hex to proto3 JSON's base64 (ids only; every other field untouched)
results.verdict: PARSED by the official proto definitions — names, kinds (1 INTERNAL, 3 CLIENT), attributes, status and timestamps all carried

results.attempt: POST the protobuf above, content-type: application/x-protobuf

checks.trace_id_preserved: 50444de04d35c6f7240486f96a9041f8 in the file == trace_id Phoenix stored
checks.parent_chain_preserved: both the agent span and the model span name bbx.run's span id as parent
checks.semconv_read_by_the_importer: Phoenix derived llm.system/llm.provider/llm.model_name from our gen_ai.* attributes — the names are not decoration
checks.our_names_stored_verbatim: every bbx.* attribute came back unchanged

conclusions.ticket_sentence: P4-14 asks that "a Phoenix/Langfuse-class importer accepts the file". Measured: Phoenix does NOT accept the JSON file (415), and DOES accept an equivalent protobuf encoding of the same spans (200, read back with the trace id and parent chain intact).
conclusions.status: P4-14 stays wip: the file we ship is JSON, and the importer rejects that encoding. The failure is in the encoding, not the content — which is what the read-back proves.
not_tested: Langfuse (no OTLP receiver installable offline here)
the OTLP/HTTP JSON receiver of an OpenTelemetry Collector (not available offline)
conclusions.proposal: Ship a second derived part, otlp/spans.pb (protobuf, stdlib-only encoder), so the capsule carries the encoding a real receiver takes. Recorded in docs/STATE.json extra_work as P4-20.
